style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 40cm Pre Lit Christmas Eucalyptus Wreath With White Berries
style.toneOfVoice: <p>This pre lit eucalyptus and white berry wreath is a festive favourite and a super stylish addition to your home for Christmas. Incorporating a classic design, this quality wreath has been paired with micro lights to give it that extra wow factor! </p><p>The faux eucalyptus leaves and berry detailing adds to its appearance, with the benefit of being able to use it again for following Christmases. Style it on the mantelpiece or use as an elegant centrepiece for the table. Measuring at 50cm in diameter, it’s a real showstopper when paired with our 50 warm white micro fairy lights.</p><p>The 4.9m green wire is brilliantly bendable, so even though your garland is pre wrapped, you can still style your lights however you like. Simply pop in the batteries and use the handy 6 hour timer function for a sparkling look each evening.</p>
